Affiliate disclosure

This site is free to use. To pay for it, we may earn a commission when you sign up for some software through links on this site.

Right now

No affiliate links are live yet. Every link goes to the provider's official website, as listed by HMRC.

How affiliate links are marked

  • Next to every affiliate button we say it's an affiliate link.
  • Affiliate links carry rel="sponsored nofollow", so search engines know they're paid links.
  • A commission never decides whether a product is listed, how it's sorted, or what we say about it. Products we earn nothing from are shown in exactly the same way.

Our emails

If you get our Free MTD Ready Kit, our emails may sometimes mention software we earn a commission from. When they do, we say so in the email, and the same rules apply: a commission never changes what we recommend.

Other ways we may earn in future

If we ever show sponsored placements or refer you to an accountant for a fee, we'll label it clearly on the page where it appears.
